comment: UI key sets (F1 UI foundation: US-1.2, US-1.3, US-1.4, US-0.10 title footer, US-17.1). Screen ids mirror ui/screens.json; UiNames are the UXML name= regions (04 UPPER_SNAKE); UiClasses are the USS classes code toggles; UiKeys are the keys of ui/*.json; UiValues are their wire values. UiDataTests keep these in step with the content and the UXML. F1 first fight adds W-04 creation (Class pane), W-07 combat with the Combatant kit element, W-20 pause, and the planned rewards, pile viewer, armoury and run end.

keySets.name: UiNames
keySets.doc: UXML element names (04 region names; Q<T>(UiNames.X) lookups and screens.json focusOrder entries).

keySets.name: UiClasses
keySets.doc: USS class names code toggles (bands and layout on the root, states, tones, kit variants; *Prefix values are joined with a data value).

keySets.name: UiKeys
keySets.doc: Keys of ui/screens.json, ui/menus.json, ui/layout.json, ui/tokens.json, ui/components.json and ui/confirmationPolicies.json.

keySets.name: UiValues
keySets.doc: Wire values used in ui/*.json (layers, back behaviour, transition modes, PanelSettings match modes, policy levels, slot modes).

keySets.name: UiPlaceholders
keySets.doc: Named placeholders in UI string templates ({name}).

keySets.name: UiFormats
keySets.doc: Formatting conventions: template placeholder delimiters, string-key conventions (08 §9) and invariant number/date formats.

keySets.name: SlotSummaryKeys
keySets.doc: The slot summary a run save carries in its payload (read by the title preview and W-03 rows).

keySets.name: TokenKeys
keySets.doc: Tokens code reads (ui/tokens.json): durations for hold-to-confirm, refusals, tooltips, the gate and boot; the clear colour.

keySets.name: UiResources
keySets.doc: Resources paths of the UI theme, the UI art catalog and the kit UXML templates (Unity/Assets/Game/Presentation/UI/Resources).

keys.PlannedScreen: ui: screen '{0}' is planned, not built
keys.MissingArt: ui: art '{0}' is not in the UI art catalog
keys.Booted: ui: booted with {0} content files in {1} ms
keys.NoFight: ui: the combat screen opened without a fight
keys.NoReward: ui: the rewards screen opened without a pending reward
keys.NoRun: ui: a climb screen opened without a run in the right place
keys.NoCore2Fight: ui: the Core 2 combat screen opened without a fight
keys.Core2StepFailed: ui: a Core 2 combat step threw: {0}

numberSets.name: UiMath
numberSets.doc: Unit conversions and geometry identities used by the UI (not tuning).
